question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into three segments, A, B, C. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the segment that contains the error, from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

It was (A) / by a chance (B) / he saw a movie in a theatre (C).
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"B."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is **"by chance," **not **"by a chance."**
 
• The phrase **"by chance"** means without plan or intent; accidentally.
 
 
• **Example:** *I met her again by chance in a department store in Paris.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *It was **by chance**__ he saw a movie in a theatre.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The verb tense used in segment C is correct, as the past tense **"saw" **is appropriate for describing a completed action in the past.
 
• However, the phrase **"in a theatre"** is not necessary and can be omitted without changing the meaning of the sentence.

​

 

यहां, त्रुटिपूर्ण भाग "B" है।

 
• इस संदर्भ में "by chance" का इस्तेमाल सही है, "by a chance" नहीं। वाक्यांश "by chance" का अर्थ होता है बिना किसी योजना या इरादे के; अचानक से।
 
• खंड C में प्रयुक्त क्रिया का काल सही है, क्योंकि अतीत काल "saw" एक पूर्ण क्रिया का वर्णन करने के लिए उपयुक्त है।
 
• हालांकि, वाक्य में "एक सिनेमा हॉल में" जरूरी नहीं है और इसे हटाने से वाक्य का मतलब नहीं बदलेगा।
